title: 可组合的研发工作流
thesis: Lead 从确认的设计版本选取本轮活动，开发与 Reviewer 在独立工作页交付变更、核对原始证据并退回修复。
journey: 在版本页查看人的签认，带入编排画布后启动 R-028。运行页把 G3 的 diff 与自测交给 Reviewer。RV-028 根据 CSV 第 3 行将 F-24 退回原活动，修复页对照 7c9a24e 与 8d26b17，独立重取 CSV 后衔接活动 09。各页可回到对应源版本、运行记录或首次评审。

references.title: Barly Design for Uxerflow · Vectra – AI Dashboard – Workflow
references.author: Barly Design for Uxerflow
references.observed: 在工作室原片 9.0 秒的 800×600 帧中，应用约从 x=18 到 782，左栏约占可见应用宽度的 19%。画布蓝色触发节点在橙色 Agent 上方，中性叶节点沿细线扇出，边缘工具与底部浮动工具条避开主体。13.0 秒的右侧设置抽屉约占应用宽度的 27%。15.0 秒的执行记录停靠在画布下缘。按原片显示尺寸估计，正文约 7–8 像素，控件高约 15–18 像素。定稿采用桌面 1× 的 13 像素正文和 28 像素按钮。

references.title: Uxerflow · Vectra – AI Dashboard – Overview
references.author: Uxerflow
references.observed: 13.4 秒能看到完整的浅色应用。顶栏与筛选动作各占一短行，白色内框之间用低对比细线分开。底部表格有浅灰表头和约 28 像素高的原片数据行。工作页取其表格与窄工具栏关系，主体改为签认正文、样例核对和可逐行读取的 CSV 证据。20.0 秒另核对了同一应用的页签与数据行排列。

pages.title: 编排画布
pages.focus: Lead 把已确认的 v3、既有架构及按条件进入的 ADR 接入活动 06。活动 07 取得 CP-07，G3 与 G4 分别位于交接连线上。节点可打开源版本，底栏能启动 R-028。
pages.method: 内置 ImageGen 读取 Workflow 9.0 秒与 13.0 秒原帧，探索蓝色来源、橙色 Lead、小节点头和右抽屉的组合。逐项核对草案后，用静态 HTML/CSS 与矢量连线重排实际活动、回退边及停止条件，再由 Chromium 以 1× 输出最终中文 PNG。
pages.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design ONE 1600 × 960, edge-to-edge desktop application screenshot at normal 1× browser zoom, not a Dribbble presentation. The two attached frames are the actual Vectra Workflow by Barly Design for Uxerflow, frames at 9 and 13 seconds. Use ONLY those frames as visual authorship: fine dot-grid barely visible, near-white work canvas with faintly blue-gray side rail, a white selected row, very small colored node header strips (indigo for a confirmed design, apricot/orange for the Lead agent), soft native edges, dotted orange auxiliary relations and small circular ports, little right-edge controls, floating bottom-center toolbar. A white node configuration inspector occupies 24% of screen only on selection. Remove the original navy exterior movie matte; zoom the application itself edge to edge. Reinterpret the screen with all original Fouc content. Chinese productivity application for ADD collaborative R&D. Main canvas shows confirmed document 《任务导出设计》v3 leading to an orange “Lead 编排”, a selected “实现与局部测试” and linked “独立评审” connected downstream; small leaf inputs “沿用架构”, “按需 ADR”, “Context Pack” and the path to “集成与回写”. Nodes in a spatial constellation, credible connections with minimal crossings. No copied brands or integrations. Selected node inspector assigns a developer and cites AC-02 “导出结果仅含当前筛选命中且本人可见的任务”, a verification responsibility and stop condition. Sidebar wordmark Fouc with narrow near-neutral rail, one selected work navigation entry and a short recent activity list; project switcher at top only, header named “按筛选导出任务”. Discreet blue action “启动运行”, edge actions and small editing controls. Actual body text 12–14 px, regular weights, node titles 13–15 px, buttons 24–29 px; use 100% scale, no giant type or headers. First productive content near y=105. Carefully laid out calm, credible, quiet desktop workspace with gentle tonal differences, ample canvas but densely usable node contents. Do not make a poster, metrics, decorative numbers, huge illustration, gradients across panels, or kanban. Flat orthographic view, no surrounding device.

pages.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. One full-bleed, normal 1×, 1600×960 desktop application screen for Fouc in Chinese. The first supplied frame is from Uxerflow Vectra Overview at 13.4 seconds and the second from Vectra Workflow at 13 seconds. These are the sole visual reference, by Barly Design for Uxerflow. Preserve their fine cool blue-gray left rail, very quiet white inset main window, flush compact global toolbar, low-contrast panel borders, hierarchical but modest type, fine table rhythms, tidy upper-right small blue primary action and selection accent. Do not reuse a dashboard chart, KPIs, labels or a navy outer film frame. Create an original “独立评审” work surface for the running R-028 “按筛选导出任务”. Top-level rail Fouc, “研发工作流” selected. A project switcher exists only at the top. At the top of the white main area show the source “任务导出设计 v3”, “AC-02”, and the commit 7c9a24e. A large work area shows a real proof comparison of authorization test data: F-16 matches and is visible, exported as expected; F-24 matches but is not visible to the requesting member, expected excluded, observed in CSV row 3; F-31 does not match, excluded. Right inspector shows the independent reviewer’s finding, a short decision with return owner and the button “退回活动 07”. Show source and actual CSV side-by-side or stacked in one quiet evidence surface, using neutral headers and only one pale red failed row. At lower edge place an execution-event table, as in Vectra Workflow. Actual 12–14 pixel body letters, compact 24–29 pixel controls, first substantive work near y=110. App intended for professional careful daily use, restrained white/blue-gray materials, no pictorial clutter, no blob backgrounds, no poster titles, no decorative oversized numerals. Desktop screenshot, straight-on edge to edge.

verification: 5 张完成图均为实际 1600×960、DPR 1。按图序，第一个业务对象、目标或验收正文的顶部是 121、130、134、138、134 像素。工作正文字号为 13–14 像素，标准按钮 28–29 像素。已逐张目视比对 Uxerflow 原帧，检查端口、连线、文件名、三个样例、CSV 行号与时间先后。13 个跨页热点取自最终排版的边界坐标。资料使用当前仓库真实文件名，人员、运行、提交标识及证据均为同一交互示例。内置 ImageGen 生成五份阶段草案，最终画面的中文、图形和控件经静态重排后输出。
